profileEvidence.author: B
profileEvidence.summary: Wire-haired Dachshunds can be playful and responsive companions while remaining vigorous, persistent workers outdoors. Digging is part of their hunting inheritance, and their weather-resistant coat was developed for demanding terrain. Their terrier ancestry helped shape the variety, but they still share the Dachshund’s nose-led, above- and below-ground hunting skills.
profileEvidence.shortDescription: The wire-haired Dachshund often mixes playful companionship with persistent hunting drive and a strong urge to dig.
